admin.description: First listmonk admin account, created on the first install

username.description: Login name for the first admin account, 3 characters or more

password.description: Password for the first admin account, 8 characters or more. Used only on the first install; change it later from Admin -> Users in listmonk. Leave empty to generate one into the <release>-admin Secret

image.description: listmonk container image, e.g. listmonk/listmonk:v6.2.0. Raising the tag upgrades listmonk and migrates its database on the next rollout - back up Postgres first. Set service.initContainer.image to the same value

initContainer.description: Init container that installs and migrates the database

image.description: Must be the same image as service.image: it runs the database migrations that image expects. The install fails if the two differ

nginx.description: nginx Ingress for listmonk. Created only when host is set

host.description: Hostname to serve listmonk on, e.g. lists.example.com. Leave empty and no Ingress is created. Then set Settings -> General -> Root URL in listmonk to match

tlsHost.description: Hostname to put in the TLS certificate. Defaults to the host above

tlsSecretName.description: Name of an existing Kubernetes TLS secret holding the certificate for that host

minCPU.description: CPU reserved for the listmonk pod, e.g. 100m

minMemory.description: Memory reserved for the listmonk pod, e.g. 128Mi

maxCPU.description: CPU ceiling for the listmonk pod, e.g. 500m

maxMemory.description: Memory ceiling for the listmonk pod, e.g. 512Mi

volumeMounts.description: Storage attached to the listmonk container

pvc.description: Disks mounted into listmonk. The default entry gives the media uploads directory a 5Gi volume. Set "storage" to change the size, at install time only - a live volume cannot be resized

postgres.description: Bundled PostgreSQL holding subscribers, lists, campaigns, templates and settings

diskSize.description: Disk for the bundled PostgreSQL, e.g. 10Gi. Fixed at install time - a live volume cannot be resized afterwards
